headline: Three-day tobacco permit suspensions approved for 7-Eleven at 63 Mammoth Road and Lowell Quick Stop.
summary: 7-Eleven sold a pack of Marlboro cigarettes for $17 to a minor on August 19, and can resume selling on the 21st. Lowell Quick Stop sold a pack of cigarettes to an 18-year-old on March 27 and has paid a $1,000 fine. Its suspension runs from November 18th through the close of business on the 20th. The PrideSTAR monthly opioid report was also accepted as mailed.
decisions: Approved three-day tobacco permit suspension for 7-Eleven, 5-0, starting November 18th.
Approved three-day tobacco permit suspension for Lowell Quick Stop, 4-0.
Approved PrideSTAR monthly opioid report as mailed.
discussion: Tobacco penalty counting: Members asked whether violations older than the two-year window could bring a harsher penalty. The program director said the local rule copies state law, and that the city could make its own rule stricter.
Lowell Quick Stop letter: The owner could not attend and sent a letter, which the chair read aloud. It says the ticket was addressed to the former owner and asks not to be penalized further.

Development Services year figures: The senior sanitary code inspector reported 1,043 food establishment inspections, 1,701 rental unit inspections, and 7,791 complaints from January 1st to yesterday. Also 51 new restaurants opened in that period.
Flu and TB clinic: The director said there are five active TB cases and a clinic backlog of months. Flu clinics are on Tuesdays the 10th and 17th from 3:30 to 6:30.
Measles vaccination rates: Members asked for MMR rates in Lowell public schools at next month's meeting. Staff said a few grades are reported to the state, usually in January.

decision_evidence.quote: My recommendation would be a three consecutive day suspension to begin on Wednesday, November 18th. ... Okay. So, can we just get a vote? Jo-Ann? Yes. Bill? Yes. Kathleen? Yes. Ali? Yes. And Erin. Yes.
I have no problem recommending the three days. Right. So, is that a motion? Sure. Second. Seconded by Ali? Yes. Roll call. Joanne? Yes. Bill? Yes. Kathleen? Yes. Ali? Yes.
Okay. Report accepted as mailed. Emailed.
